title: Console backend: optimization config history + diff + rollback action (with confirmation payload)
creator: Chloe Martin
description:
Problem
- Console needs server-side endpoints to power:
  1) Optimization Config change history timeline (who/what/when + scoped filters)
  2) Diff view between versions (schema-aware + “risky field” highlighting support)
  3) Rollback action initiated from Console with guardrails: blast radius summary, concurrency/race safety, RBAC checks, and audit emission.

Scope
- Implement Console backend endpoints (Console service) that call into Optimization Config Service + RBAC + audit.
- Provide a “confirmation payload” flow so UI can display an accurate blast radius summary and submit a rollback request that is safe against TOCTOU (active version changing between modal open and confirm).

Non-goals
- Implementing control-plane rollback semantics (handled by Optimization Config Service + runtime applier).
- Fully automated rollback without confirmation (out of scope per PRD).

Proposed Console backend API (internal)
1) List history
- GET /console/v1/optimization-config/history
  - Query params:
    - tenant_id (required)
    - model (optional)
    - region (optional)
    - environment (hosted|dedicated|private) (optional; default inferred)
    - limit / cursor
  - Returns an ordered timeline of apply/promote/rollback events plus version metadata.
  - Must support filtering by scope (tenant/model/region) and include status for partial rollouts.

2) Diff
- GET /console/v1/optimization-config/diff?from_version_id=...&to_version_id=...
  - Returns a diff that is:
    - human-readable (normalized config keys)
    - includes validator hints (semantic warnings/errors) when present
    - includes “risk flags” for fields (e.g., quant_profile_id, cache_mode, max_batch_tokens)

3) Rollback confirmation (preflight)
- POST /console/v1/optimization-config/rollback/prepare
  - Input:
    - tenant_id
    - scope: model/region (optional)
    - target_version_id (the version to roll back to)
  - Returns:
    - current_active_version_id (authoritative at time of prepare)
    - blast_radius_summary (models/regions affected, current rollout state, active canary %, if any)
    - confirmation_token (opaque; bound to tenant_id + target_version_id + current_active_version_id + scope + short TTL)
    - required_confirmation_phrase (for type-to-confirm; UX copy comes from design)
    - warnings (e.g., “Partial rollout detected; rollback will revert only applied shards first”)

4) Rollback execution (confirm)
- POST /console/v1/optimization-config/rollback
  - Input:
    - tenant_id
    - scope (model/region optional)
    - target_version_id
    - expected_active_version_id (must match prepare response)
    - confirmation_token
    - confirmation_phrase
    - reason (free text; required)
  - Behavior:
    - Enforce RBAC: optimization_config.rollback
    - Enforce cooldown: prevent repeated rollback spam (align with SRE guidance)
    - Verify expected_active_version_id matches current active pointer (prevents rolling back the wrong thing)
    - Forward to Optimization Config Service rollback endpoint and return operation_id
    - Emit audit event “optimization_config.rollback_requested” (and ensure downstream emits “rollback_completed/failed”)

Guardrails / requirements
- RBAC: align with PM-902 and policy bundle PR. Operators w/out permission should not see the rollback action and must receive a clear error (also required for support workflows).
- Audit logging: Console must emit request-side events with request_id, actor, tenant_id, scope, target_version_id, expected_active_version_id, and reason.
- Race-safety: confirm request must be rejected if active version changed since prepare.
- Pagination: history endpoint must be stable, cursor-based.
- Performance: history list for noisy tenants should avoid N+1 calls; request should complete < 500ms at p95 in internal tests (assuming cached version metadata).

Acceptance criteria
- Console UI can:
  - Render history timeline for a tenant with filters (model/region) with pagination.
  - Load a diff between any two versions present in history.
  - Open rollback modal that calls prepare, displays blast radius summary, and successfully confirms rollback only when:
    - user has permission
    - confirmation token valid
    - expected_active_version matches
- All rollback requests generate an audit log event and include the reason.
- Explicit error handling:
  - 403: insufficient permissions
  - 409: active version changed (stale prepare)
  - 422: invalid confirmation phrase / validation error
  - 429: cooldown/rate limit
- Integration test coverage for:
  - prepare -> confirm happy path
  - stale prepare (active changes) -> confirm returns 409
  - permission denied -> 403

Implementation notes
- Token format: use signed token (HMAC) with TTL (5 minutes) and include: tenant_id, scope hash, target_version_id, expected_active_version_id, issued_at.
- The prepare endpoint should call Optimization Config Service to compute authoritative blast radius summary (avoid duplicating rollout-state logic in Console).
- The confirm endpoint should call the rollback API (ENG-4825) and propagate operation_id for UI tracking.
- Add server-side “reason required” enforcement (enterprise requests from sales/security calls).

Open questions
- Partial rollout rollback semantics: if canary is paused mid-stage, does rollback revert only applied shards first or force revert across all? Need a single blast radius summary string that is accurate but not overly technical.
- Do we need “two-person rule” for enterprise tenants? (Not in initial scope; leave hook for future approval workflows.)

Notes for QA/Release
- Feature-flagged for internal beta; enable on a small set of tenants first.
- Ensure response headers include request_id for support.
- Coordinate with SRE dashboard annotations so Console-triggered rollback events show up with the same operation_id.
comments: 2025-10-09 (Jada Williams): UX needs a two-step flow: prepare returns blast radius + phrase; confirm includes expected_active_version to prevent accidental rollback after another operator applies a new config. Please also include a short TTL confirmation token so modal can’t be re-used later.

2025-10-14 (Jordan Lee): RBAC: use permission optimization_config.rollback and optimization_config.read for history/diff. Align naming with policy bundle PR; avoid role names in code. Also ensure tenant scoping is enforced server-side (no cross-tenant history).

2025-11-03 (Sean Gallagher): Add a rollback cooldown. In gameday we saw people clicking twice when UI felt slow. Even a 60s cooldown per tenant/scope would help. Also make 409 errors actionable in UI copy ("Active config changed; reopen rollback").

2025-11-19 (Marcus Lin): Audit event must include actor_type (human/service), actor_id, session_id if present, request_id, and reason. Enterprises will ask for this. Don’t rely solely on downstream service emitting completion events.

2025-12-06 (Felix Schneider): Implemented prepare/confirm flow in console-api. Using signed token with 5m TTL; confirm verifies active pointer still matches expected. Added 409 response mapping. Next: wire history pagination and diff passthrough.
2026-01-08 (Chloe Martin): Please ensure diff endpoint supports returning semantic validation warnings even if both versions are valid. UI wants to highlight riskier fields (quant profile changes).

2026-01-22 (Felix Schneider): Landed history API with cursor pagination and scope filters; added integration tests for rollback stale-prepare and permission denied. Waiting on final RBAC policy bundle update in staging to validate end-to-end.
2026-01-28 (Connor O'Brien): Marking as Done once staging validation passes with feature flag on. Ensure console-2026.02 release notes include the new 409 behavior and audit reason requirement.
